subject: MAP: procurement runway & final go/no-go
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@acme-retail.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft + evaluation close window

Hannah / Camila —

Thanks for walking us through the evaluation last week. Attached is the final MAP we used internally (MAP_v3.pdf) and a short SOC2 evidence bundle the security team requested (SOC2-evidence-summary.zip). Our procurement team has two outstanding items before they can issue a PO:

- Final legal redlines (if any)
- Confirmation of official start date and first-week onboarding schedule

We'd like to lock a go/no-go decision by next Wednesday so our execs can schedule the funding approval meeting. Can you confirm who from Redwood will be the exec approver and what signature window you can commit to? Ideally we want signatures and PO in hand by 2027-01-27 to make a 2027-02-10 start realistic.

Thanks —
Jordan Lee
Head of Procurement
Acme Retail

Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + evaluation close window

Jordan —

Appreciate the materials and clarity on the procurement timing. Quick read-through: the MAP looks good and the SOC2 bundle addresses the questions our security reviewer had. I attached a living MAP tracker (MutualActionPlan_Acme_AdHoc.xlsx) with suggested owner assignments and dates.

Proposed next steps and timeline (suggested):
- 2027-01-18: Legal redline submission (Redlines in parallel)
- 2027-01-20: Exec approval (Redwood exec sign-off) — target for go/no-go
- 2027-01-21 to 2027-01-27: DocuSign signature window + PO issuance
- 2027-02-10: First day of onboarding and integration kickoff

Action items for Redwood:
- Laura: quick pass on contract redlines and confirm any required SLA modifications
- Hannah: confirm exec approver for final sign-off and any credit/discount approvals required
- Karthik / Aditya: prepare a short onboarding calendar and estimate of first 30 days (resource list + ramp plan)

Jordan — is the 2027-02-10 start date still the desired target if PO/signatures land by 1/27? If procurement needs an earlier signature window, flag the dates you need and we'll prioritize.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MutualActionPlan_Acme_AdHoc.xlsx (xlsx)]

Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + evaluation close window — legal redlines

Camila / team / Jordan —

I reviewed the draft SOW and master purchase terms. High-level: no material blockers, only cleanups we should address before DocuSign. Main items:

1) Start date flexibility: redline to allow a 2-week start-window (target 2027-02-10, +/- 7 days) to account for procurement timing.
2) Data retention clause: clarify retention period for cached inference logs and how Redwood will handle deletion requests.
3) Liability cap: standard language tied to fees for first 12 months — suggest we keep current threshold.
4) IP/Derivatives: small clarification that customer outputs are theirs; model underlying IP remains Redwood's.

Requested timeline:
- Please accept/confirm these redlines by 2027-01-20 so we can circulate the DocuSign packet on 2027-01-21.
- We should aim for a signature window 2027-01-21 through 2027-01-27. If procurement requires an earlier sign-off, let us know the exact cutoff.

I've attached the redline file (redlines_acme_20270118.docx) and prefilled DocuSign link for the current version: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCD-1234-ACME.

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-retail.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Final: approval lock & start-date confirmation

Jordan / all —

Thanks for the clear timelines. Confirming Redwood's final position: we can commit to the proposed start date of 2027-02-10 contingent on two items being complete before DocuSign is closed:

1) Procurements: PO issued and scanned copy received by procurement@redwood.ai no later than 2027-01-27
2) Signatures: executed DocuSign envelope returned and archived (we'll send the packet 2027-01-21)

If both items are received by 1/27 we will:
- Lock the onboarding calendar and resource assignments (Aditya to lead first 30 days)
- Confirm any applied credits/discounts and finalize billing start date

If procurement needs a hard signature earlier than 1/27, we can accommodate a narrow earlier window (2027-01-24 to 1/26) with prior notice; otherwise 1/27 is our last day to ensure the 2/10 onboarding slot.

Next steps (owners):
- Camila: coordinate DocuSign packet and confirm signer order by 2027-01-21
- Laura: finalize redlines (deadline 2027-01-20) and approve final envelope
- Karthik: confirm any commercial exceptions and communicate credit numbers by 2027-01-20
- Aditya: prep onboarding plan skeleton and send first draft by 2027-01-22

Jordan — confirm receipt of this note and let us know if Acme will commit to PO + DocuSign by 1/27. Once you reply with the commitment we'll treat this as the final go decision and proceed to schedule the onboarding kickoff for 2027-02-10.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
